items: A plastered ceiling slab. Drop it at the top of the storey: its bottom face is the record's y.
A T-bar grid with tile panels, one tile every `tiles` metres — offices, shops, corridors.
The visible floor layer over the slab: give it mat_timber for a plank floor, mat_stone for tiles.
A skirting board along one wall: len along its own +X, h tall, t proud of the wall face.
An access floor: deck plate on a pedestal grid `pedestals` metres apart, h to the top of the deck.
